status_policy.PLANNED: Case definition exists; no solver evidence yet.

status_policy.PASS: Actual CFDX solver execution, conservation, quantitative QoI agreement and reproducible evidence are all present.
status_policy.BLOCKED: Required capability or trustworthy reference configuration is absent.

cases.boundary_conditions: Dirichlet wall temperature on end patches; fixed heat flux (positive into the domain, mono-zone patch); adiabatic elsewhere
cases.numerical_schemes: Two-point finite volumes; series-resistance face conductance G = A/(d/(2k_o)+R_c+d/(2k_n)); half-cell Dirichlet; source added per cell volume
cases.solver_settings: Steady linear solve via the scalar solver chain (CG/GMRES/Gauss-Seidel/dense-LU fallback); tolerance 1e-14 relative; relaxation 1.0
cases.convergence_criteria: Linear solver CONVERGED status and finite residual_inf; observed refinement order gated to (1.5, 2.5) on the 8/16/32 series
cases.conservation_criteria: Independent boundary-flux reconstruction (audit_thermal_boundary_flux); energy closure |source - net boundary flux| / gross throughput < 1e-12; exact mid-plane cumulative-power identity with adiabatic upstream wall
cases.qoi: Cell-centre temperatures, per-patch heat flux, total source power, relative energy imbalance
cases.reference_value: Resistance-network temperatures exact at cell centres; parabola T(x)=T_R+q'''(L^2-x^2)/(2k) second order; mid-plane flux = q'''L/2

cases.case: Fluid energy stage, frozen-flow coupling, volumetric power, heated walls, imposed heat flux
cases.reference: Steady forced-convection energy equation carried by the incompressible solver authoritative conservative face mass flux (Patankar 1980, DOI 10.1201/9781482234213); exact discrete oracle (independent Thomas solve of the assembled upwind finite-volume system) computed in the test
cases.parameters: 1-D chain n=16, L=4 m, unit cross-section; rho=1.2 kg/m^3, mu=1.8e-5 Pa.s, k=0.026 W/(m.K), cp=1005 J/(kg.K); u_in=1.5 m/s; volumetric power 5000 W/m^3; T_in=293.15 K; heated wall 350 K; imposed wall flux 500 W/m^2
cases.mesh: Structured orthogonal 1-D chains (columns of 4 points, 4 wall faces per cell); n=16 (dx=0.25 m)
cases.boundary_conditions: Dirichlet inlet temperature; zero-gradient outlet; lateral walls adiabatic, Dirichlet wall temperature, or fixed heat flux (positive into the domain)
cases.numerical_schemes: Upwind convection on the frozen authoritative face mass flux; two-point diffusion; half-cell Dirichlet; fixed wall flux as a boundary gradient q''/k; one-way fluid-to-energy coupling without outer iteration
cases.solver_settings: Carrier flow via solve_steady_incompressible (SIMPLE, upwind) initialized from rest (U=0) with default under-relaxation alpha_u=0.7 / alpha_p=0.3 (initializing at the exact plug solution freezes the relative-residual gates at ~1, monitor STAGNATED, issue #663); then solve_energy with dt=0 (steady), relaxation 1.0, tolerance 1e-12, linear_tolerance 1e-14, temperature_tolerance 1e-12, energy_balance_tolerance 1e-12; pressure gauge anchored on the OUTLET cell n-1: the reference cell's continuity row is eliminated from the pressure system, so an inlet-cell anchor removes the only row that can balance the injected inlet mass and the plug becomes an unreachable fixed point (pressure-correction CG failing at ~509 iterations, residual ~1e-4 - the red CI of the PR #888 fix commit 3a35ef5e, not cured by rest initialization alone); the outlet anchor converges geometrically at rate (1 - alpha_p), ~90 iterations from rest within the 200-iteration budget
cases.convergence_criteria: Carrier flow converged with uniform plug velocity and mass flux; energy stage verdict is blocking (the independent audit is a verdict, not a diagnostic): linear_solver_converged AND global_energy_balance_passed AND local_energy_balance_passed AND all results finite; local_energy_balance_passed requires BOTH the gross-scale normalized local gate and the per-cell gate normalized by each cell's own gross power scale (its face throughputs + source + accumulation, floor 1 W)
cases.conservation_criteria: Independent energy-balance reconstruction (reconstruct_energy_balance) normalized by the gross audit power scale (total boundary throughput |q_f| + source power, floor 1 W): blocking gates: global, local (max cell residual, strictly stronger, immune to residual compensation) and the per-cell normalized local gate (each cell's residual against its own gross power scale), all < 1e-12 (energy_balance_tolerance); outlet flux equals total source power for adiabatic walls; per-patch boundary flux audit
cases.qoi: Cell-centre temperatures, min/max temperature, total source power, per-patch boundary flux out, outlet temperature
cases.reference_value: Exact discrete oracle at machine precision; plug-flow outlet temperature T_in + q'''L/(rho cp u); boundary_flux_out = q'''L (adiabatic walls) or 4 q''L (imposed wall flux)
cases.error: Oracle agreement below 1e-9 K; normalized conservation below 1e-12; maximum principle respected
cases.observed_order: The oracle is the exact discrete solution on a frozen first-order upwind flux, so no refinement order is claimed; refinement series deferred to the physical campaign
cases.runtime: Milliseconds per chain (unit test runs in fast CTest, labels qualification;validation;phase13)
cases.regression_status: test_production_energy_stage_vv in CI; READY is not PASS: physical promotion requires the real-solver campaign (cfdx_production_solver on a .cfdx.h5 case) executed on an exact merged HEAD with retained evidence (governance #118); post-merge fix branch: root cause of the red CI (pressure gauge anchor on the inlet cell - the eliminated continuity row cannot balance the injected inlet mass) fixed by anchoring on the outlet cell, plus stage-contract hardening (heat_flux on WALL patches only, Dirichlet+heat_flux contradiction rejected, dynamic_viscosity required, per-cell normalized local gate, explicit solid_conduction/compressible routing, complete geometry contract)

cases.case: Buoyancy-affected turbulent upflow in a heated vertical pipe
cases.reference: Upflow turbulent mixed convection heat transfer in vertical pipes, International Journal of Heat and Mass Transfer 41 (1998), 4037–4054, DOI 10.1016/S0017-9310(98)00177-X; supplemental 2026 high-fidelity dataset DOI 10.57745/6CGPI4 is numerical, not experimental.
cases.parameters: Water upflow in heated vertical pipe; Re=Ub*D/nu, Pr=nu/alpha, Gr=g*beta*DeltaT*D^3/nu^2, Ri=Gr/Re^2; exact operating points and reference-property convention transcribed from the selected experiment.
cases.mesh: At least three refinements; near-wall thermal/hydrodynamic boundary-layer resolution; report y+, radial resolution, axial development length and outlet sensitivity.
cases.boundary_conditions: Upward mass flow; measured inlet temperature and velocity/turbulence; uniform wall heat flux or exact experimental thermal BC; gravity orientation and property model explicit.
cases.numerical_schemes: SST with buoyancy coupling as baseline; compare property-constant Boussinesq and variable-property formulation only as distinct subcases when justified.
cases.solver_settings: Steady RANS baseline only for reference conditions with steady statistics; record buoyancy production and turbulent heat-flux closure/Pr_t.
cases.convergence_criteria: Residuals plus stabilization of pressure drop, wall shear, Nu and axial/radial temperature profiles; monitor possible relaminarization and redeveloping turbulence.
cases.conservation_criteria: Mass conservation; integrated wall heat input equals enthalpy rise plus losses; momentum balance includes hydrostatic and buoyancy terms.
cases.qoi: U(r), T(r), wall temperature, local/mean Nu, tau_w, Cf, pressure drop, turbulence statistics and their variation with Ri.
cases.reference_value: Published experimental profiles/correlations/tables; point-by-point operating conditions and uncertainties must be transcribed before execution.
cases.error: Profile and integral QoI errors with experimental uncertainty; compare at identical axial stations and property definitions.
cases.observed_order: At least three spatial resolutions; report spatial and model-form sensitivities separately.
cases.runtime: Per Re/Ri point, mesh and turbulence model.
cases.regression_status: PLANNED: physical reference identified; exact test matrix, tabulated reference data and buoyancy-capable production turbulence path must be audited before qualification.

cases.case: OECD/NEA–Vattenfall turbulent thermal mixing in a T-junction
cases.reference: OECD/NEA Vattenfall T-junction benchmark, NEA/CSNI/R(2011)5; Smith, Mahaffy & Angele (2013), Nuclear Engineering and Design 264, 80–88, DOI 10.1016/j.nucengdes.2013.02.030.
cases.parameters: 1:2 scale water experiment; cold main inlet 19 °C, hot branch inlet 36 °C (DeltaT=17 K); reported flow rates 9 L/s and 6 L/s, Re≈80,000 and 100,000; exact diameters, coordinates and uncertainty from official report.
cases.mesh: Three refinements minimum; resolve junction shear layers, branch lip, wall thermal gradients and downstream mixing; assess outlet length and wall resolution.
cases.boundary_conditions: Two inlet branches with measured flow and temperature; measured/developed inlet profiles; no-slip walls; outlet pressure; temperature-dependent properties only as supported by reference.
cases.numerical_schemes: Isothermal hydrodynamic baseline first; then energy coupling; SST for mean-flow baseline; URANS/LES required for fluctuation/spectral claims.
cases.solver_settings: Separate isothermal and non-isothermal campaigns; for transient cases report time step, sampling frequency, discarded transient and statistical duration.
cases.convergence_criteria: Mass-flow split and velocity profiles stable for isothermal stage; temperature mean and probe statistics stationary for thermal stage.
cases.conservation_criteria: Branch mass balance; global momentum consistency; heat balance between inlet enthalpy fluxes and outlet/wall fluxes.
cases.qoi: Velocity profiles at reported stations including x/D=2.6 and 6.6 where applicable; mean temperature, RMS temperature, probe time series, dominant frequencies and PSD when raw signals exist.
cases.reference_value: Official OECD/NEA report and released Vattenfall measurement data; station coordinates, probe positions, sampling and uncertainty pinned per dataset.
cases.error: Mean profile and time-series metrics with experimental uncertainty; frequency-domain metrics only where sampling metadata and raw signals are available.
cases.observed_order: Three mesh refinements; at least three time steps for unsteady claims; statistical uncertainty assessed independently.
cases.runtime: Per mesh, model, physical time and sampling window.
cases.regression_status: PLANNED: public benchmark identified; geometry/probe data ingestion and transient production capability audit remain required.
